recommendation: Keep this source-changing commit. It completes the applied resolution in active ExampleScenario source without changing the data model or inventing a new Coding convention, and it avoids TestScript edits outside the current core build.
issue_request: FHIR-44499 asked how ExampleScenario should support non-FHIR operations, including whether operation type should be CodeableConcept rather than Coding and how to encode actions such as a user authorizing an activity. The Applied resolution rejected CodeableConcept, kept Coding, and requested guidance that type is optional and should be omitted when a coded value adds no benefit.
initial_application: The Jira application comment points to Git master 64f4db6650, which added a comment to ExampleScenario.instance.structureType. That historical commit did not add operation.type guidance and left wording that could be read as allowing omission of a 1..1 structureType element.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini keeps ExampleScenario active in the current core build. The Jira-cited Zulip thread raised the Coding representation question for ExampleScenario and TestScript but did not establish a canonical OperationDefinition-as-Coding convention. TestScript is no longer an active core resource in this checkout and fhir.ini links testing to the testing IG, so this reconciliation is limited to ExampleScenario. Confluence minutes show the issue was raised for list discussion and later voted as will fix 10-0-1.
reconciliation: Changed source/examplescenario/structuredefinition-ExampleScenario.xml to add explicit operation.type guidance for non-FHIR action coding and omission when no useful code exists, and replaced the structureType comment with guidance to omit the associated ExampleScenario.instance for steps that share no data structure.
source_changes: source/examplescenario/structuredefinition-ExampleScenario.xml: clarified ExampleScenario.instance.structureType comment so non-data steps omit the associated ExampleScenario.instance rather than a mandatory structureType.

source/examplescenario/structuredefinition-ExampleScenario.xml: added ExampleScenario.process.step.operation.type comment covering non-FHIR coding systems and omission of type when no useful code exists.
